name: Kawamoto Taku
source:
Hobby: Playing in general.
Special skill: He can get along with everyone right away.
Likes: Lively places, smiling people, standing out.
Hates: Dark places, being alone, quiet places.

Taku is a second grader at Hamasaki high school. He is liked by everyone in his class and likes to stand out. Taku's mood can easily be shifted from angry to calm and he is immature in both appearance and behavior.

[Translated from [url=http://memoriesoff.jp/your_psp/chara_kawamoto.html]the official site (PSP edition)[/url].]
